claims.reason: SSAB 18 August 2021, July paragraph and HYBRIT paragraph, explicitly attributes first steel to first Luleå sponge iron and reports July rolling; no lot number. Sommarbladet 2022 printed p. 7 reports a route via Ovako to Oxelösund and an August customer delivery but does not establish the first Luleå iron or document its information source. This is an informative lead, not independent traceability for the exact relation. JRC INCITE, melting section, and HYBRIT 2024 technical summary p. 14 identify Swerim trials without identifying the July lot. Swedish Energy Agency ER 2021:27 pp. 30–31 note 78 cites the same HYBRIT announcement, not an independent account. No claim of historical disproof is warranted.

Riksrevisionen §2.3.3 reports 2021 first hydrogen-reduced sponge iron; SSAB release supplies July rolling. Sommarbladet p. 7 makes the Ovako assertion without source; its reference to Sandberg's April 2022 talk concerns the conversion discussion and does not establish its source. Ovako FY2021 pp. 3 and 12, Volvo Green Steel Collaboration page, and Jernkontoret 13 October 2021 document the separate Hofors hydrogen initiative and its planned vehicle use. Volvo 13 October 2021 and Jernkontoret's event account associate the SSAB steel and load carrier with August delivery but do not identify the reduction run. HYBRIT technical summary English edition p. 14 independently inspected in place of the inaccessible large Swedish edition.

Existing Oxelösund July and Luleå 2021 events and candidate link were compared against the proposal; no duplicate discovery or new event is proposed. Riksrevisionen note 41 names HDAB's 26 August 2024 closeout report; a potentially independently checked trace remains a future question, not evidence already obtained.

corrections: At reviewer's request, researcher replaced inaccessible Volvo PDF sources with readable original Volvo HTML accounts, narrowed Jernkontoret's Hofors claim and characterized the audit office report without asserting independent corroboration.
deferred: Exact production-run, melt and rolling-lot chain of custody, and the Sommarbladet Ovako claim's provenance remain unresolved. The SSAB partner announcements and their restatements do not supply an independently informative second account.
